description: This file contains serializers, surrogates, and copiers for the ImmutableSortedDictionary<TKey, TValue> data structure from the Orleans.Serialization library. It defines a codec, a surrogate type, and a deep copier to handle serialization and copying of immutable sorted dictionaries with specific key and value comparers.

classes.name: ImmutableSortedDictionaryCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: A serializer codec for ImmutableSortedDictionary<TKey, TValue> that manages conversion to and from a surrogate and handles serialization logic.

classes.name: ImmutableSortedDictionarySurrogate<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: A surrogate type for serializing ImmutableSortedDictionary<TKey, TValue>, capturing its values and comparers.

classes.name: ImmutableSortedDictionaryCopier<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: A deep copier implementation for ImmutableSortedDictionary<TKey, TValue>, supporting shallow and deep copies.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate representation back into an ImmutableSortedDictionary<TKey, TValue>.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts an ImmutableSortedDictionary<TKey, TValue> into a surrogate representation for serialization.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the ImmutableSortedDictionary<TKey, TValue> instance, with support for shallow copying when appropriate.
